scope: Illustration reference only; not validated inverse dynamics or a replacement for adult-scale variants

anatomy.notes: Knees forward, true ankle/hocks back, long metatarsals, no human heel contact in standing

sitting.support: pelvis on low bench, toe-pads on ground

image_gate: First verify standing front-view paired roots and matching horn arcs; asymmetrical angle is permissible only from perspective
Every leg must show hip→forward knee→rear hock (true ankle)→long metatarsals→three toes
In sitting, preserve bone segment lengths and pelvis support. Do not substitute a human cross-legged pose
Three distinctly articulated digits per foot on toe pads; five fingers per hand
Tail joins sacrum; expose knee, hock, metatarsals and toes. No robes, smoke, magic circle, or camera crop may hide anatomical uncertainty
Reject the image if joint chain cannot be visually traced or if toe/horn counts are wrong; simplify to neutral anatomical drawing and retry before adding decoration

When any plantar/sole view is included, require exactly 3 distal digital pads and exactly 3 claw-bearing digits (the single large proximal/metatarsal pad is distinct and not a toe). Verify each foot separately, in every inset.
A final collage or infographic cannot inherit a PASS from source geometry; count toes, pads and horns and trace seated joint topology in EVERY PANEL, including tiny bottom-row details.
For ritual sitting, never use lotus/cross-legged human knees and attach paws. Use the verified low-bench pelvis-supported joint chain, visible grounded three-toe feet and hocks.
Never invent green checkmarks or speed/endurance/accuracy statistics as if a pixel rendering itself were a biomechanical test.

foot_ventral_contract.counting_rule: Count small separate distal pads and the individual claw-bearing digits. The larger proximal central pad is NOT a fourth toe; do not allow a fourth small digital pad or claw.
foot_ventral_contract.view_consistency: For the same left/right foot, the dorsal, frontal, side and plantar/ventral views must all correspond to the same three articulated toes and the same three digital pads.

sitting_contract.recommended_pose: pelvis supported on a low solid bench; hips flexed, knees forward, hocks farther back and low; elongated metatarsals extend from hocks to the three grounded toe pads; feet not crossed
reject: human lotus/cross-legged pose with paws glued onto human ankles
hock hidden underneath a robe or overlaid fire
feet floating, occluded, or visually disconnected from the shins
any foot drawn with four or more distal pads or terminal claws
sitting_contract.require_contact: visible physical seat support at pelvis AND toe-pads touching a grounded surface; if toes cannot be counted, panel is NOT VERIFIED.

composite_image_review.rule: A poster is accepted ONLY when every depiction of the same character in every panel separately passes the visible-image audit. One incorrect closeup invalidates the whole poster.
composite_image_review.test_status: Do not draw performance numbers, green checkmarks, VALIDATED labels, simulated speeds, balances or endurance unless backed by a named actual calculation and evidence reference, never as decoration.
composite_image_review.if_view_obscured: Mark NOT ASSESSABLE and reject final poster until rendered in a clear anatomy-first view.
composite_image_review.automated_unit_tests_limit: Passing JSON landmark or audit-schema unit tests does not prove raster toe count or model biomechanics. Pixel inspection is still required.
